osool-101.title: Boiled Meat with Mastic and Cardamom
osool-101.culturalNotes: Boiled meat is only served fully cooked. Bones can also be boiled on their own for stock: put them in cold water, skim off the scum, then leave them over low heat for a long time with onion, carrot, turnip and celery to flavor the broth.

instructions.1: Put the meat into boiling water with the onion, salt, pepper, mastic and cardamom.
instructions.2: Leave it on the heat until tender, skimming off the scum whenever it appears. Approximate times: lamb 20 minutes per ½ kg plus 20 minutes; beef and large cuts 25 to 30 minutes per ½ kg plus 30 minutes; veal 30 minutes per ½ kg plus 20 minutes.
instructions.3: Lift the meat out of the water, garnish with parsley and lemon and serve; keep the broth for cooking other dishes or serve it as soup.

instructions.1: Mince the meat two or three times; you can also pound it in a mortar after mincing.
instructions.2: Add the remaining ingredients to the meat, knead well with the egg and season; the mixture should be slightly soft, and you can add another egg if needed.
instructions.3: Spread out a clean piece of cheesecloth and dust it with flour; shape the mixture into a medium-thick cylinder, place it on the cloth and smooth it well.
instructions.4: Roll the cloth around the cylinder, gather the ends, twist them tightly and tie.
instructions.5: Boil the roll in salted boiling water for an hour.
instructions.6: Lift it out of the water, remove the cloth, wrap it in a clean cloth or buttered paper greased with ghee and leave it to cool.
instructions.7: Brush it with glaze and serve whole, garnished with lettuce and tomatoes, or cut it into thin slices, arrange them on a plate and garnish with lettuce and tomatoes.

osool-103-i6.name: Large onion, carrot and a piece of celery

instructions.1: Remove the bone from the meat, spread it out and beat it well with a mallet or pestle to break down the fibers, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Spread half the sausage over the meat, leaving an inch free on all four edges, and sprinkle this layer with a little seasoning.
instructions.3: Spread the rest of the sausage to form a second layer.
instructions.4: Roll the meat up tightly into a cylinder, then wrap it in a piece of cloth, gather the ends, twist them tightly and tie with kitchen string.
instructions.5: Put it into boiling water with the removed bone, an onion, a carrot, a piece of celery, salt and peppercorns, and let it boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Lower the heat and simmer until done (two to three hours), adding hot water if the level in the pot drops.
instructions.7: Lift it out and let it cool slightly, then remove the cloth, wrap it in a clean cloth and tie it well.
instructions.8: Place it between two boards or plates, press it down with a weight and leave until completely cold.
instructions.9: Brush with glaze and serve garnished with parsley or lettuce leaves; you can also decorate it with chopped clear aspic.

osool-104.title: Boiled Lamb Head with White Sauce

osool-104-i2.name: Onion, carrot and a piece of celery

osool-104-i3.name: Salt and flour for cleaning the brain

osool-104-i4.name: For the white sauce: ghee or butter

osool-104-i6.name: For the white sauce: milk or the cooking broth

instructions.1: Remove all the cartilage and wash the head well, paying attention to the nose and ears, then soak it in salted water for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Blanch the head by putting it in cold water over medium heat until it boils, then drain; remove the brain and tongue and scrape the head and teeth.
instructions.3: Blanch the tongue the same way, then peel off its skin.
instructions.4: Put the head and tongue into boiling water and simmer over low heat for two hours, then add the onion, carrot and celery and cook until the head is tender.
instructions.5: Clean the brain with salt and flour, removing the blood vessels and membrane; wash it, tie it in cheesecloth and blanch it as before.
instructions.6: Put the tied brain into the pot with the head and cook everything for 20 minutes, then lift out the head, tongue and brain.
instructions.7: For the white sauce: melt the ghee, take it off the heat and stir in the flour, then return to low heat for 3 to 4 minutes without letting it color; take it off the heat, add the boiling liquid all at once while stirring quickly, then return to the heat and boil for 5 to 7 minutes and season.
instructions.8: Carefully remove the bones from the head and place it on a warm plate, covered with the white sauce or left uncovered.
instructions.9: Garnish with cubes of tongue, pieces of brain and a few cooked vegetables, and serve the broth the head was cooked in as soup.
instructions.10: Lamb head with brain sauce: cook the head the same way with a bundle of parsley, thyme, bay leaf and black peppercorns tied in cheesecloth, adding ¼ small cup of rice in the last hour; make the brain sauce by adding the chopped boiled brain, 1 teaspoon lemon juice and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley to 1 cup of white sauce, cover the meat with it and arrange the tongue in slices around it.

osool-105-i4.name: For the sauce: white sauce (ghee, flour and milk or broth)

osool-105-i5.name: For the sauce: finely chopped parsley

instructions.1: Clean and blanch the head and remove the brain and tongue as for lamb head.
instructions.2: Put the head on the heat, cover with cold water and add the chopped vegetables and the tongue.
instructions.3: Simmer over low heat until tender, skimming off the scum whenever it appears.
instructions.4: Add the cleaned brain, tied in cheesecloth, twenty minutes before the end of cooking.
instructions.5: Make the white sauce (1 tablespoon ghee and 1 tablespoon flour per cup of liquid) and stir in the chopped parsley while it is hot.
instructions.6: Lift out the head, place it on a plate and remove the bones while keeping its shape as far as possible, then cover it with the parsley sauce.
instructions.7: Garnish with the tongue cut into rounds, lemon and pieces of brain.
instructions.8: Cold veal head: boil the head the same way and let it cool, then remove the bone and arrange the meat on a plate over a bed of shredded lettuce; garnish with the tongue, tomatoes, green olives and onion, and serve with French dressing.

osool-106.title: Veal Trotters with Egg and Cream Sauce

osool-106-i3.name: Carrot, onion and a piece of white celery

osool-106-i4.name: Flour dissolved in a little water

osool-106-i5.name: Light white sauce made with the cooking broth

instructions.1: Scrape the hair off the trotters, scrub them with a loofah and soap, rinse several times, then wash with flour.
instructions.2: Split the hoof and crack the bone crosswise without separating the pieces, then blanch by putting them in cold water, bringing it to a boil and draining.
instructions.3: Boil them in water with the vegetables, seasoning and the well-mixed flour until tender.
instructions.4: Remove the bones and arrange the meat on a plate.
instructions.5: Make the light white sauce from the cooking broth.
instructions.6: Beat the egg yolks and add them to the sauce, stirring well, then heat gently for 3 minutes while stirring without letting it boil; add the lemon juice.
instructions.7: Cover the meat with the sauce and garnish the plate with the fried bread triangles.

osool-107.title: Cold Trotters with Parsley and Vinegar Dressing

osool-107-i9.name: Shredded lettuce, tomatoes and lemon, for serving

instructions.1: Clean and blanch the trotters as for veal trotters with egg and cream sauce.
instructions.2: Boil the trotters with the water and vegetables until completely tender.
instructions.3: Remove the bones and let the meat cool.
instructions.4: Mix the dressing ingredients (oil, vinegar, parsley, onion, salt and pepper) and marinate the cold meat in it for at least half an hour, turning from time to time.
instructions.5: Lift the meat out of the dressing and arrange it on a plate over a bed of shredded lettuce; garnish with tomatoes and lemon.

osool-108-i7.name: White sauce or parsley sauce (1 tablespoon ghee and 1 tablespoon flour per cup of milk)

instructions.1: Remove the membrane and blood vessels, rub the brains gently with salt and flour and rinse well.
instructions.2: Put the brains in a pot of salted water and leave for 20 minutes, then bring the pot to a boil for 5 minutes. You can wrap the brains in a piece of cloth before putting them on the heat.
instructions.3: Rinse the brains in cold water, then put them back on the heat with fresh water and boil for 5 to 10 minutes with the onion, salt, lemon juice, mastic and cardamom.
instructions.4: Lift them out of the water and let them cool, then cut as desired or leave whole.
instructions.5: Serve covered with white sauce or parsley sauce, or garnished with lemon and parsley.

instructions.1: Wash the tongue well and scrape it with a knife to remove the rough outer layer.
instructions.2: Rub it well with salt, then with flour, and rinse repeatedly.
instructions.3: Put it in a pot, cover with cold water and bring to a boil over low heat for 5 minutes, then change the water for fresh cold water.
instructions.4: Return it to low heat and add the salt, the onion and a piece of cheesecloth holding the cardamom, cloves and peppercorns.
instructions.5: Leave it on the heat until tender, then lift out the tongue and peel off its skin.
instructions.6: Serve it whole and hot, garnished with lemon and parsley.
instructions.7: Or let it cool, cut it into rounds, cover with mayonnaise and garnish with lettuce and a few pickles.
instructions.8: Or cut it into cubes, cover with lemon-parsley sauce (white sauce made with white stock, lemon juice and chopped parsley) and serve hot.
instructions.9: Or sauté the boiled tongue in ghee, then lift it out, cut into rounds and serve with lemon and tomato slices.

osool-110-i3.name: Onion rubbed with salt and pepper

osool-110-i5.name: White sauce, or celery or parsley sauce

instructions.1: Gently rub the sweetbreads with salt to draw out the blood, then clean them, wash with flour and clean again.
instructions.2: Put them in a pot, cover with salted cold water and bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then drain.
instructions.3: Pour fresh cold water over them and set over low heat with an onion rubbed with salt and pepper; cook until tender.
instructions.4: Serve hot, covered with white sauce and garnished with parsley, or covered with celery sauce or parsley sauce.

osool-111-i2.name: Flour, soap and a loofah for cleaning

osool-111-i6.name: For the onion sauce: white sauce

osool-111-i7.name: For the onion sauce: large onions

osool-111-i8.name: Lemons cut in halves, for serving

instructions.1: Scrape off the dark-colored parts and remove the fatty pieces.
instructions.2: Scrub the tripe well with a loofah and soap and rinse repeatedly, then rub it with flour and rinse with cold water.
instructions.3: Cut it as desired, put it in a pot, cover with cold water and bring to a boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Drain off the boiling water, replace it with fresh water and repeat once more.
instructions.5: Cover with cold water with the onion, mastic and cardamom and cook until nearly done, then add the salt and continue cooking until fully tender.
instructions.6: For the onion sauce: peel and boil the onions, then lift them out of the water, drain, chop, add to the white sauce and season.
instructions.7: Serve the tripe hot with salt, pepper and halved lemons, or cut it up and cover with the onion sauce.

osool-112-i5.name: For the sauce: strained cooking broth

instructions.1: Wash the spleens with flour and clean them well.
instructions.2: Season with salt, pepper and half the lemon juice and leave for about a quarter of an hour.
instructions.3: Put them in a pot, cover with water and add the onion, the rest of the lemon juice and a little salt; bring to a boil, then lower the heat and cook until tender.
instructions.4: Lift them out of the water; mix the sauce ingredients (broth, oil and lemon) and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.5: Cut into thick slices, arrange on a plate, garnish with lemon and parsley and serve with the sauce.
instructions.6: Or sauté briefly in very hot ghee and serve with parsley and lemon, keeping the frying pan covered because spleen spatters; turn it over, then cover again.

osool-113-i3.name: Onion rubbed with salt and pepper

instructions.1: Rub the lung with salt and wash it, then rub with flour and rinse.
instructions.2: Cut into suitable pieces, put in cold water and bring to a boil over low heat for 5 minutes, then drain.
instructions.3: Put them in fresh cold water, repeat the process and drain.
instructions.4: Put them in fresh cold water with the onion rubbed with salt and pepper and a little cardamom, and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley and lemon.

osool-114-i5.name: Dried parsley leaves, a little thyme and bay leaf

instructions.1: Remove the bones and the skin layer from the meat and flatten it well.
instructions.2: Season it, then roll it up tightly and tie with kitchen string.
instructions.3: Put the prepared vegetables and the spice bundle in a pot with just enough water to cover the vegetables, place the meat on top and cover with greased paper.
instructions.4: Cook over low heat with the lid tightly closed, turning from time to time, until the meat is tender.
instructions.5: Lift out the meat, place it between two boards or trays, press it under a weight and leave until completely cold, then cut into thin slices.

osool-115.title: Veal Rolls with Brown Sauce and Mashed Potatoes

instructions.1: Cut the meat into steak slices 3 inches long and 2 inches wide and flatten them well.
instructions.2: Roll each slice up like a stuffed roll and tie with string, then marinate in the onion juice, salt, pepper, cloves, nutmeg and lemon for half an hour.
instructions.3: Brown the meat in the ghee and lift it out, then brown the flour in the same ghee until it turns brown.
instructions.4: Take the pot off the heat and add the stock gradually, stirring constantly, then add the marinade juices and bring to a boil, still stirring.
instructions.5: Add the meat and simmer over low heat until tender, then remove the string from the rolls.
instructions.6: Make a bed of mashed potatoes and arrange the cooked meat on top; strain the sauce, pour it around the dish and serve hot.

osool-116.title: Stuffed Beef Rolls with Tomato Sauce and Rice

osool-116-i4.name: Light baladi bread, soaked and squeezed

osool-116-i11.name: Carrot and a piece of celery, chopped

instructions.1: Pound the meat and cut it into rectangles (3 × 2 inches).
instructions.2: Wash the meat and season it with salt, pepper, nutmeg and onion juice.
instructions.3: Mix the minced meat, garlic, parsley and squeezed bread and season everything well.
instructions.4: Spread the minced meat mixture over the steak slices, roll each piece up and tie with string, then brown the meat in the ghee and lift it out.
instructions.5: Add the strained tomatoes to the ghee left from browning and cook until done, then add the vinegar and the stock or water and bring to a boil.
instructions.6: Add the meat and chopped vegetables and cook until the meat is tender.
instructions.7: Place the cooked rice on a plate in a hollow ring; lift the meat out of the sauce, remove the string and place it in the center of the rice.
instructions.8: Strain the remaining sauce, season it and pour it over the meat.

instructions.1: Brown the meat in the ghee and lift it out, then brown the onions and lift them out.
instructions.2: Brown the flour in the remaining ghee until it turns brown, then take the pot off the heat and add the stock gradually, stirring well.
instructions.3: Return the pot to the heat and let it boil for 3 minutes.
instructions.4: Layer the meat, onions and carrots alternately in a tagine dish, pour the strained brown sauce over them, cover and bake in a moderate oven until the meat is tender.
instructions.5: Wrap a folded napkin or a paper frill fixed with a pin around the tagine and serve it on a larger plate.

osool-118.title: Lamb in White Sauce with Peas and Carrots

instructions.1: Sauté the meat in the ghee, then add the water and cook until nearly tender.
instructions.2: Mix the flour well with the milk and add it to the meat while stirring.
instructions.3: Leave the pot over low heat until the meat is fully cooked, then add half the vegetables and boil for 3 minutes.
instructions.4: Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice, ladle onto a plate and garnish with the rest of the carrots and peas.

instructions.1: Add a little salt to the onions and stir over medium heat until they absorb their liquid and turn golden; add a very little water and stir until it is absorbed, and repeat until they are fully browned, then add the ghee and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomato and the meat and stir everything over low heat for 10 minutes, then pour in a little water and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Put the onions and meat into a tagine dish, cover and bake in the oven.
instructions.4: Remove the lid shortly before it is done so the top can brown.
instructions.5: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine, fix it with a pin and serve on a plate.

instructions.1: Separate the tail joints, then split each one crosswise with a cleaver.
instructions.2: Wash the joints well and put them into boiling water with a whole onion; cook until nearly tender, then add salt and boil for about 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Brown the chopped onions with a little salt over medium heat, sprinkling with a little of the oxtail broth whenever they dry out, until fully browned; then add the ghee and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the strained tomato and the boiled oxtail joints and stir everything for 10 minutes, then pour in a little of the oxtail broth and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Put everything into a tagine dish, cover and bake in the oven until done, removing the lid at the end so the top browns.
instructions.6: Serve the tagine on a larger plate.

instructions.1: Brown the meat in the ghee and lift it out, then brown the onions and lift them out.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomatoes to the remaining ghee and cook until done.
instructions.3: Pour in the water or stock and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Add the meat and onions and season; cover the pot, lower the heat and cook until tender.

osool-122-i7.name: Cooking apple or green tomato, chopped

osool-122-i11.name: Sugar, or 1 teaspoon jam or raisins

instructions.1: Cover the coconut with the water and heat gently for an hour, then strain off the coconut milk and discard the coconut.
instructions.2: Brown the meat lightly in the ghee and lift it out.
instructions.3: Fry the onion in the remaining ghee until golden, then add the curry powder and stir briefly.
instructions.4: Add the flour and stir until it browns slightly, then add the apple and stir everything well.
instructions.5: Add the stock and coconut milk gradually, stirring constantly, and bring to a boil; then lower the heat and add the sugar.
instructions.6: Put the browned meat into the sauce and simmer over low heat until tender, one to two hours, skimming off the fat whenever it appears; season the sauce and add the lemon juice.
instructions.7: Place the boiled rice on a plate in a hollow ring with the curried meat in the middle; garnish with lemon and parsley and serve the rest of the sauce in a sauceboat.
instructions.8: Curry with cooked meat: make the curry sauce and simmer it over low heat for an hour to bring out the flavor of its ingredients, then add chopped cooked meat, boil for a quarter of an hour and serve as above.

osool-123-i1.name: Veal (one flattened piece of breast or leg)

osool-123-i6.name: Salt, pepper and nutmeg or ground cinnamon

instructions.1: Spread out the meat and pound it to break the fibers, no more than half an inch thick, then season with salt, pepper and nutmeg or cinnamon.
instructions.2: Spread the sausage over it, leaving half an inch free at the edges.
instructions.3: Roll it up tightly into a cylinder and tie with linen kitchen string.
instructions.4: Put the chopped vegetables in a pot and pour over just enough water to cover them.
instructions.5: Place the meat on top of the vegetables and cook over low heat or in the oven, keeping it covered.
instructions.6: Every half hour, lift the lid, turn the meat over and add a little water if needed; cook until done (about two hours), then lift it out and remove the string.
instructions.7: Serve cold, brushed with glaze and garnished with lettuce and tomatoes, with a vegetable salad.
instructions.8: Or serve hot with a brown sauce made from the vegetable broth it cooked in, garnished with boiled carrots.
instructions.9: Meat stuffed with spiced mince and pine nuts: replace the sausage with spiced minced meat mixed with a few pine nuts and proceed the same way.

osool-124.title: Veal Stuffed with Tail Fat and Garlic

osool-124-i2.name: Sheep tail fat, cut into small pieces

instructions.1: Spread out the meat, pound it, then season with salt, pepper and allspice.
instructions.2: Push half garlic cloves into the meat at intervals.
instructions.3: Scatter the tail fat over the surface of the meat, then roll it up and tie with linen string.
instructions.4: Sauté the meat in the ghee, then add a little water and cover the pot.
instructions.5: Lift the lid from time to time, turn the meat and add a little water, and continue until the meat is tender.
instructions.6: Lift it out of the pot, remove the string and place it on a plate with its cooking juices around it; garnish with the boiled potatoes, or serve cold garnished with parsley or lettuce and a few tomatoes.

osool-125-i1.name: Young veal, cut into medium pieces

osool-125-i2.name: A piece of celery, an onion and a carrot

osool-125-i3.name: Cloves, cardamom and black peppercorns in cheesecloth

osool-125-i4.name: For the white sauce: ghee and flour

instructions.1: Cut the meat into even, medium-sized pieces, and the vegetables the same way.
instructions.2: Put the meat, vegetables and spices in a pot with enough stock or water to cover them; cover the pot and cook over low heat until the meat is tender.
instructions.3: Make a thick white sauce with 3 cups of the remaining cooking liquid and boil it well.
instructions.4: Take the sauce off the heat until it cools slightly, then add the cream and lemon juice and season; reheat over low heat, stirring constantly.
instructions.5: Arrange the meat on a warm plate, cover it with the thick sauce and garnish with lemon and parsley.

osool-126.title: Liver in Tomato Sauce with Garlic and Vinegar

osool-126-i10.name: Salt and pepper (a little chili can be added)

instructions.1: Wash the liver, cut it into medium-thick slices and marinate in salt, pepper, lemon juice and onion juice for half an hour.
instructions.2: Coat in flour, fry in very hot oil and lift out.
instructions.3: Fry the chopped garlic in 2 tablespoons of the remaining oil, then add the strained tomatoes and cook until done; add the vinegar and a little water and season the sauce.
instructions.4: Cut the fried liver slices into cubes, add them to the sauce and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
instructions.5: Ladle out and garnish with parsley.

instructions.1: Wash the liver and cut it into slices, then put it in a pot and season with salt, pepper, lemon juice and onion juice; leave for about an hour.
instructions.2: Put the pot on the heat and stir the liver until it reabsorbs its juices, then add the ghee, brown it lightly and lift it out of the pot.
instructions.3: Fry the chopped onion in the remaining ghee; when it turns golden, add the flour and keep stirring until it turns brown, then add the stock or water gradually, stirring well.
instructions.4: Bring the sauce to a boil over low heat, then add the browned liver, cover the pot and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Ladle out, cover with the sauce and garnish with lemon and parsley.

osool-128-i7.name: For the brown sauce: stock or water

instructions.1: Cut the prepared tripe into rectangles (3 × 2 inches), roll them up, tie and season.
instructions.2: Put the seasoned chopped vegetables in a pot, cover with a little water and place the tripe rolls, seasoned with salt and pepper, on top.
instructions.3: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until the tripe is tender, then remove the string.
instructions.4: For the brown sauce: brown the flour in the ghee until reddish brown, then add the stock gradually, stirring well; bring to a boil and strain.
instructions.5: Make a bed of potato purée, arrange the tripe rolls on top, pour the sauce around them and garnish with a few carrots.
instructions.6: Tripe in tomato sauce: brown a chopped onion in 1 tablespoon ghee, add 4 chopped garlic cloves and stir until golden, then add 1 cup strained tomatoes and cook until done, followed by 1 cup of the tripe broth; season, add the boiled, chopped tripe and simmer over low heat for half an hour.

osool-129.title: Stuffed Tripe with Vegetables and Tomatoes

instructions.1: Clean the tripe and cut it into rectangles (3 × 2 inches).
instructions.2: Mince the leftover tripe trimmings, add the garlic and parsley and season with salt and pepper; stuff the tripe pieces with this mixture, roll them up and tie.
instructions.3: Put the vegetables in a pot, cover with the stock and tomatoes and season, then place the tripe rolls on top.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and cook in a moderate oven until tender, adding some water if needed.
instructions.5: Lift out the tripe, remove the string, arrange on a warm plate and strain the sauce over it.

osool-130.title: Brains in Parsley and Lemon Sauce

instructions.1: Clean the brains and parboil them as for boiled brains.
instructions.2: Make the white sauce, add the brains and simmer over low heat until cooked.
instructions.3: Take the pot off the heat, lift out the brains and place them on a warm plate.
instructions.4: Add the parsley and lemon juice to the sauce, season well and pour it over the brains.

instructions.1: Brown the onion in the ghee, then add the garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomatoes and cook until done, then add the vinegar and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the trotter broth, season and bring to a boil (this is the dama sauce).
instructions.4: Remove as much of the bone from the trotters as possible, then put them in the sauce, cover the pot and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.
instructions.5: Arrange the trotters on a warm plate and pour the sauce around them.
instructions.6: Lungs in tomato sauce: made the same way, using boiled, chopped lamb lung instead of the trotters.

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients and pound them well in a mortar.
instructions.2: Shape into fingers or rounds and fry lightly in very hot ghee.
instructions.3: Lift out of the ghee, arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.4: Meat and liver kofta: made with the same ingredients, adding ⅛ kg minced liver to the mixture.

osool-133-i2.name: Asag (minced meat cooked with onion and ghee)

instructions.1: For the asag: mix ½ kg coarsely minced meat with a sliced onion, season and stir over low heat until it absorbs its juices; add a little water and let it be absorbed, then add 1 tablespoon ghee and stir until the meat browns slightly.
instructions.2: Mix all the ingredients except the eggs and pass them through the fine plate of a mincer.
instructions.3: Knead well with the eggs, shape as desired and fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Serve arranged on a plate and garnished with parsley.
instructions.5: Kofta with boiled rice: add 2 tablespoons of boiled rice to the mixture after mincing and before binding with egg; shape into medium-thick rounds and fry, or coat in egg before frying, and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-134.title: Leftover Meat and Potato Kofta
osool-134.culturalNotes: An economical way to use up leftover boiled or cooked meat.

instructions.1: Mince the cooked meat, mix all the ingredients together and bind with the egg.
instructions.2: Shape into patties or fingers as desired.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Serve garnished with parsley, or with tomato sauce.

osool-135.title: Fried Lamb Chops (Costoletta)
osool-135.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-135-i5.name: Fried potatoes, or potato purée and sautéed peas, for serving

instructions.1: Prepare and wash the meat; scrape the meat off the top of the bone for about an inch and trim the excess fat, then beat the meat to break the fibers and give it its shape.
instructions.2: Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice, and onion juice if desired.
instructions.3: Pat the meat dry and fry it in the very hot ghee, turning it quickly on both sides at first to seal the surface, then lower the heat until cooked through.
instructions.4: Lift the meat out and drain it thoroughly of ghee; serve hot with fried potatoes or sautéed peas, or with potato purée and tomato or brown sauce.
instructions.5: Second method: coat the prepared meat in seasoned flour (1 tablespoon flour with ½ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper) and fry in ghee as above; serve with potato purée, pour the sauce around and garnish with sautéed vegetables.
instructions.6: Third method: lightly beat an egg with a little salt and pepper and dip the chops in it, then coat in 3 tablespoons fine breadcrumbs, pressing with a knife, and fry in ghee; put a paper frill on the end of each bone or wrap it in foil.

osool-136.title: Mock Cutlets from Cooked Minced Meat
osool-136.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-136-i3.name: Very thick white sauce (panada): ghee, flour and milk
osool-136-i3.standardAmount: 2 tablespoons ghee and 2 tablespoons flour per cup of milk; use half this amount

osool-136-i5.name: Small pieces of macaroni for the 'bone'

instructions.1: Make the very thick sauce and mix it with the cooked minced meat and parsley; knead well and season.
instructions.2: Spread the mixture in a greased dish in a round and leave to cool, then cut it into four pieces.
instructions.3: Shape each piece like a cutlet and insert a piece of macaroni into its pointed end.
instructions.4: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry.
instructions.5: Serve with potato purée and brown sauce or tomato sauce, or on their own garnished with parsley.

osool-137.title: Lamb Chops with Spaghetti, Tomato and Cheese
osool-137.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-137-i7.name: For the tomato sauce: small onion and carrot

instructions.1: For the tomato sauce: sauté the vegetables in the ghee, then add the stock and tomatoes and cook until done; press through a sieve, add the cornflour mixed with a little water and boil for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring.
instructions.2: Prepare the meat as for chops and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs, deep-fry in plenty of ghee, then lift out and drain thoroughly.
instructions.4: Mix the spaghetti with a little tomato sauce, pile it in the center of the plate in a mound, sprinkle the grated cheese on top and arrange the fried chops around it.
instructions.5: Serve the rest of the tomato sauce alongside in a sauceboat.

osool-138.title: Curried Lamb Chops with Rice
osool-138.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Season the prepared meat with salt, pepper and curry powder.
instructions.2: For the curry sauce: fry a small onion in 1 tablespoon ghee, add curry powder and flour and stir, then add 1 cup stock while stirring, simmer over low heat and add a little lemon juice.
instructions.3: Coat the meat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Boil the rice and shape it on the plate into a hollow ring; arrange the chops inside the ring and fill the center with a little boiled rice.
instructions.5: Pour the curry sauce around the outside of the ring and serve hot.

osool-139.title: French-Style Chops
osool-139.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-139-i5.name: For the marinade: salt, pepper and nutmeg

instructions.1: Prepare the chops as for costoletta and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Mix the marinade ingredients, add the prepared chops and leave for a quarter of an hour, then lift them out and coat in breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot and fry the chops, turning them quickly on both sides first, then lower the heat until cooked through; lift out and drain.
instructions.4: Serve on a layer of mashed potatoes with the tomato or brown sauce poured around, and put a paper frill on the end of each bone.

osool-140.title: Lamb Chops with Rumi Cheese Sauce
osool-140.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-140-i3.name: Grated rumi cheese (for the sauce and sprinkling)

instructions.1: Prepare the meat, season with salt and pepper, then fry in very hot ghee until half cooked.
instructions.2: Lift out, trim neatly and place a weight on the chops so they take an even shape; leave until completely cold.
instructions.3: Make the cheese sauce by adding 2 to 3 tablespoons grated cheese to the white sauce; coat both sides of the chops with it, sprinkle with grated cheese and leave to cool.
instructions.4: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry again in very hot ghee.
instructions.5: Arrange on a plate and garnish with the boiled potatoes brushed with warm ghee and covered with chopped parsley.

osool-141.title: Veal Steaks on Tomato Rounds with Mashed Potatoes
osool-141.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Prepare the meat by pounding and flattening it, season with salt and pepper, then fry in the ghee.
instructions.2: Make a bed of mashed potatoes, or pipe it into rosettes, one per steak, or into wide ribbons using a piping tube.
instructions.3: Place the tomato rounds on a greased tray and warm them in the oven for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Arrange the steaks on the bed and place a tomato round in the center of each.
instructions.5: Decorate each tomato round with a small rosette of mashed potato and serve the steaks with the sauce around them or alongside.

osool-142.title: Minced Meat Steaks with Onion Rings
osool-142.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Mix the minced meat with the parsley, seasoning and mashed potatoes if using, bind with the egg yolks and shape into round steaks.
instructions.2: Coat the steaks in flour and fry in very hot ghee, either deep or shallow.
instructions.3: Slice the onions into rings; separate the large outer rings and set them aside.
instructions.4: Chop the rest of the onion and fry it in 1 tablespoon ghee, then cover with some of the brown sauce and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Coat the onion rings in flour, dip them in egg white, then in flour again and fry.
instructions.6: Make a bed of mashed potatoes and arrange the steaks on it neatly; place a fried onion ring on each steak with a little of the onion and sauce mixture inside it, pour the remaining sauce around the plate and serve hot.

osool-143.title: Steaks and Balls from Cooked Minced Meat
osool-143.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Mix the sauce with the cooked minced meat and parsley, knead well and season.
instructions.2: Spread in a round in a dish greased with ghee and leave to cool, then cut into 4 to 6 pieces and shape into rounds like steaks.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Arrange the steaks on a plate and garnish with parsley, or serve on a bed of potato purée with tomato or brown sauce.
instructions.5: Meat balls on fried bread: shape the same mixture into balls, coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry, and stick a small parsley stem into each ball so it looks like an apricot; cut white bread into 2.5 cm thick slices, then into 5 cm rounds with the center removed, fry them, and set each ball on a fried bread ring.

osool-144.title: Leftover Meat Fingers in Batter
osool-144.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-144-i5.name: For the French batter: warm water

osool-144-i6.name: For the French batter: whisked egg white

instructions.1: Mix the ingredients, knead well and season.
instructions.2: Roll the mixture out and cut into 3 cm pieces, shaping them like bottle corks.
instructions.3: For the batter: sift the flour with salt, make a well in the center and add the oil, then add the water gradually while beating until smooth; leave for half an hour, and fold in the whisked egg white just before using.
instructions.4: Dust the shaped pieces with a little flour, then dip them in the batter.
instructions.5: Deep-fry, then lift out onto paper to absorb the ghee.
instructions.6: Garnish with parsley and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-145.title: Fried Liver in Seasoned Flour
osool-145.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-145-i2.name: Flour seasoned with salt and pepper

instructions.1: Rinse the liver in cold water, then put it in a bowl, pour over enough boiling water to cover with a little salt and leave for a quarter to half an hour.
instructions.2: Lift it out of the water, pat dry and cut into slices 1 cm thick.
instructions.3: Mix the flour well with the salt and pepper and coat the liver slices in it.
instructions.4: Heat the ghee until very hot and fry the liver on both sides until light brown.
instructions.5: Arrange the slices in a ring in the middle of a plate lined with parsley and serve hot.
instructions.6: Or brown the rest of the seasoned flour in the ghee left from frying, add a cup of liquid to make a brown sauce, arrange the liver in a ring on the plate and pour the sauce into the center.
instructions.7: Fried liver with lemon: cut the liver into thin slices and season with salt, pepper, lemon juice and onion for 10 minutes, then drain, pat dry and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon flour; fry in 1½ tablespoons ghee or 3 tablespoons oil and serve garnished with parsley and lemon, hot, or cold if fried in oil.
instructions.8: Quick braised liver: cut the liver into cubes and season with salt, pepper, lemon and onion for half an hour, then stir over low heat until it absorbs its juices; add 1 tablespoon ghee and brown it, then pour in a little water gradually until cooked.

osool-146.title: Fried Brains, Served Several Ways
osool-146.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-146-i2.name: Flour seasoned with salt and pepper

instructions.1: Prepare and boil the brains (soak in salted water, boil for 5 minutes, rinse, then boil again for 5 to 10 minutes with onion and lemon).
instructions.2: Pat dry, cut into pieces and coat them lightly in the seasoned flour.
instructions.3: Fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Serve with fried potatoes and garnish with parsley.
instructions.5: Brains in egg: cut the cooked brains into thick slices, season with salt and pepper, then dust with a little flour; dip in beaten, seasoned egg and fry in ghee; serve with potato purée and tomato sauce.
instructions.6: With an oil marinade: marinate the brain slices in 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 teaspoon chopped parsley, salt, pepper and nutmeg for 5 minutes, then turn them in flour, dip in egg and fry; garnish with parsley and lemon.
instructions.7: Brains in omelette batter: cut the brains into small pieces; mix 2 eggs with 1 teaspoon chopped parsley, a small chopped onion, salt and pepper; dip the brains in the mixture and fry.
instructions.8: Brains in egg and breadcrumbs: coat the pieces in flour, then in egg and breadcrumbs, and deep-fry in plenty of ghee; serve hot or cold.
instructions.9: Brains in batter: coat the seasoned pieces in French batter and deep-fry in plenty of ghee, then lift onto paper to absorb the ghee; garnish with parsley and lemon and serve with a green salad.

osool-147.title: Brain Croquettes
osool-147.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Chop the cooked brains, season with salt and pepper and mix with just enough egg to bind.
instructions.2: Stir the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens.
instructions.3: Spread the mixture on a greased plate and leave to cool.
instructions.4: Cut and shape into rounds, coat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.5: Garnish the croquettes with parsley and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-148.title: Fried Brains with Cauliflower
osool-148.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-148-i2.name: Boiled cauliflower, divided into small florets

osool-148-i3.name: Flour seasoned with salt and pepper

instructions.1: Cut the cold boiled brains into suitable pieces and coat them in the flour.
instructions.2: Pat the boiled cauliflower florets dry and coat them in flour as well.
instructions.3: Coat the brains and cauliflower in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Arrange the brains and cauliflower alternately on a plate, garnish with parsley and lemon and serve hot or cold.

osool-149.title: Fried Sausages in Egg and Breadcrumbs
osool-149.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-149-i5.name: Fried bread pieces sized to the sausages, or mashed potatoes

instructions.1: Prick the sausages with a fork, parboil them in a little water and lift out.
instructions.2: Remove the casings and coat the sausages in a little seasoned flour.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Serve on the fried bread or on mashed potatoes with brown sauce.
instructions.5: Simple fried sausages: prick, parboil, dry and fry lightly in a little ghee; serve with potato purée and brown or tomato sauce, or with fried eggs for breakfast.
instructions.6: Sausages in batter: prepare as above and coat in flour, then dip in French batter and deep-fry in plenty of ghee; garnish with parsley and lemon and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-150.title: Sweetbreads in Batter
osool-150.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-150-i3.name: French batter (flour, oil, warm water and whisked egg white)

instructions.1: Cut the cooked sweetbreads into suitable pieces and season.
instructions.2: Dust the pieces with a little flour, then dip them in the French batter.
instructions.3: Deep-fry and lift out carefully onto paper to absorb the ghee.
instructions.4: Arrange on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve the tomato sauce in a sauceboat.

osool-151.title: Sweetbreads with Spinach Purée
osool-151.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-151-i4.name: Spinach purée (boiled and mashed with butter)

instructions.1: Cut the sweetbreads into slices half an inch thick and season.
instructions.2: Coat each piece in béchamel sauce and leave to cool.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs, then deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Make a ring of potato purée, arrange the fried sweetbreads on it, then fill the center of the ring with the spinach purée.
instructions.5: Pour the tomato sauce around the plate and serve hot.
instructions.6: Sweetbreads with cauliflower: made the same way, replacing the spinach with boiled cauliflower florets coated in egg and breadcrumbs and fried, arranged alternately with the sweetbreads.

osool-152.title: Fried Heart
osool-152.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Cut the heart into suitable pieces, rub with salt and wash, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Put it in a pot on the heat until it absorbs its juices, then add the ghee and brown it.
instructions.3: Pour in a little water from time to time, stirring, until cooked.
instructions.4: Arrange the pieces on a plate, pour over the remaining liquid, garnish with parsley and serve hot.

osool-153.title: Fried Kidneys
osool-153.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Remove the excess fat and split the kidneys in half lengthwise.
instructions.2: Remove the core, tubes and outer membrane; leave the halves whole or cut them up, then soak in warm salted water for a quarter of an hour, lift out and pat dry.
instructions.3: Season with salt and pepper, put in a pot over low heat and stir until they absorb their juices, then add the ghee and brown them in it.
instructions.4: Pour in a little water gradually until cooked.
instructions.5: Garnish with parsley and pour the remaining liquid around them.

osool-154.title: Charcoal-Grilled Lamb Chops
osool-154.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-154-i6.name: Sautéed vegetables, potatoes and grilled tomatoes, for serving

instructions.1: Prepare and trim the meat, scraping the meat off the top of the bone for about an inch.
instructions.2: Beat the meat to break the fibers, then season with onion juice, lemon juice, salt and pepper and leave for a while.
instructions.3: Brush with ghee and grill over direct heat (charcoal, for example).
instructions.4: Serve with sautéed vegetables, potatoes and grilled tomatoes, or any one of them; garnish with parsley and lemon and serve hot.

osool-155.title: Grilled Lamb Skewers with Tail Fat
osool-155.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-155-i3.name: Juice of a lemon and of a large onion

instructions.1: Cut the meat into small pieces and season with salt, pepper, onion juice and lemon juice.
instructions.2: Thread onto skewers, alternating a piece of meat with a piece of fat, then grill.
instructions.3: Place on a warm plate and garnish with parsley and lemon.

osool-156.title: Grilled Kidneys
osool-156.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Remove the fat and split the kidneys in half; remove the core, tubes and outer membrane, soak in warm salted water for a quarter of an hour, then pat dry.
instructions.2: Season with salt, pepper, onion juice and lemon.
instructions.3: Grill over direct heat.
instructions.4: Serve on buttered toast, or arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.5: With suet: thread a piece of seasoned kidney onto the skewer followed by a piece of the removed kidney fat, and so on; grill like grilled meat and arrange on a warm plate lined with chopped parsley.

osool-157.title: Grilled Liver
osool-157.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-157.culturalNotes: When prepared for the sick or for children, season it with salt only, or with salt and lemon.

instructions.1: Rinse the liver in cold water and cut it into slices ½ cm thick.
instructions.2: Season with salt, pepper, lemon juice and onion juice for 15 minutes.
instructions.3: Grill over direct heat.
instructions.4: Garnish with parsley and lemon and serve hot.

osool-158.title: Kofta Wrapped in Caul Fat
osool-158.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients together and knead well with the ghee, then add the pine nuts.
instructions.2: Cut the caul fat into equal pieces, fill each piece with a portion of the mixture and roll it up like stuffed cabbage.
instructions.3: Grill on skewers.
instructions.4: Garnish with parsley and tomatoes.

osool-159.title: Roast Veal with Bread Stuffing
osool-159.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-159-i2.name: For the stuffing: stale white breadcrumbs

osool-159-i4.name: For the stuffing: grated zest and juice of a lemon

osool-159-i6.name: For the stuffing: egg or milk for binding

instructions.1: For the stuffing: mix the ingredients with ¼ teaspoon salt and a little white pepper and bind with egg into a fairly soft mixture.
instructions.2: Spread out the meat and pound it to break the fibers so it is no more than half an inch thick; season with salt, pepper and allspice, then spread the stuffing over the meat, leaving half an inch free at the edges.
instructions.3: Roll it up tightly, tie with linen string and place it in a tray with the ghee spread over the bottom.
instructions.4: Roast in a hot oven for a quarter of an hour, then lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.5: Open the oven every 20 minutes and baste the roast with the juices in the tray so the surface does not dry out, turning it over halfway through.
instructions.6: Put the small peeled potatoes in the tray around the meat half an hour before it is done so they cook and brown, then lift out the meat and remove the string.
instructions.7: Place the meat on a plate with the potatoes around it and serve with the brown sauce.
instructions.8: Roast stuffed with eggs: replace the stuffing with hard-boiled eggs dusted with flour, laid on the meat with the meat rolled around them; cook the same way and serve cold, sliced into rounds, with a vegetable salad.

osool-160.title: Roast Lamb with Mint Sauce
osool-160.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-160-i5.name: For the mint sauce: chopped fresh mint

osool-160-i8.name: For the mint sauce: boiling water

instructions.1: Wash the meat and season with salt, pepper and allspice; make slits in it at intervals and push the garlic cloves into them.
instructions.2: Place in a tray with the ghee spread over the bottom and roast in a hot oven for a quarter of an hour, then lower the heat and cook until done, opening the oven every 20 minutes to baste the meat with the juices in the tray.
instructions.3: For the mint sauce: dissolve the sugar in the boiling water, add the chopped mint and vinegar and leave for a while for the flavor to develop.
instructions.4: Serve the meat cold with the mint sauce.

osool-161.title: Stuffed Shoulder with Liver and Bread
osool-161.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-161-i4.name: White bread soaked in milk and squeezed

osool-161-i10.name: Light brown sauce and small potatoes, for serving

instructions.1: Bone the meat so that it forms a pocket.
instructions.2: Mix the stuffing ingredients, season with salt and bind with the eggs; stuff the meat with it and sew it closed.
instructions.3: Tie the outside with linen kitchen string, place in a tray with ghee and put it in the oven.
instructions.4: Roast until done, basting from time to time with the ghee in the tray.
instructions.5: Remove the string and place the meat on a plate, drizzled with the light brown sauce, or cut it into slices and arrange them on the plate; garnish with small oven-roasted potatoes.
instructions.6: Shoulder with bread stuffing: remove the shoulder blade, season and fill with bread stuffing, then sew closed; wrap in greased paper and roast in a tray with ghee (20 to 25 minutes per ½ kg plus 20 to 35 minutes), basting with ghee several times, and serve with brown sauce.
instructions.7: With spiced mince and pine nuts: stuff the shoulder with asag (spiced cooked mince) and pine nuts instead of the stuffing, and serve with brown sauce or with fluffy pasta or rice.

osool-162.title: Oven-Baked Stuffed Veal Heart
osool-162.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-162-i2.name: Bread stuffing (breadcrumbs, parsley, lemon zest, ghee and egg)

instructions.1: Wash the heart well and pat dry; hollow out the center and fill it with the bread stuffing.
instructions.2: Wrap in greased paper, place in a tray with ghee and bake in a moderate oven for an hour, basting with ghee from time to time.
instructions.3: Remove the paper, sprinkle the heart with a little flour and cook for another half hour.
instructions.4: Place the heart on a warm plate and drizzle with the brown sauce.

osool-163.title: Minced Meat Roast Wrapped in Caul Fat
osool-163.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients well, season and knead thoroughly.
instructions.2: Shape into a medium-thick cylinder and wrap it in the caul fat.
instructions.3: Bake in a hot oven for a quarter of an hour, then lower the heat somewhat and cook until done.
instructions.4: Serve hot with brown sauce, or cold with a lettuce or vegetable salad.

osool-164.title: Meatloaf
osool-164.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-164-i3.name: Bread soaked in milk and squeezed

osool-164-i8.name: Light brown sauce or vegetable salad, for serving

instructions.1: Mix the ingredients together and bind with the egg.
instructions.2: Roll into a log, wrap in greased paper and place in a tray with a little ghee.
instructions.3: Bake in a moderate oven for an hour.
instructions.4: Serve hot with the light brown sauce, or cold with the vegetable salad.

osool-165.title: Minced Meat Roast Stuffed with Eggs
osool-165.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-165-i6.name: Flour seasoned with salt and pepper

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients together and knead well with the egg.
instructions.2: Peel the boiled eggs and dust them with a little flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Spread out the meat mixture and lay the boiled eggs on it side by side; roll it up and smooth it well around the eggs, then brush with ghee and wrap in greaseproof paper brushed with ghee.
instructions.4: Bake in a hot oven for a quarter of an hour, then lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.5: Leave to cool, then cut into slices and serve with a vegetable or lettuce salad.
instructions.6: Minced meat roast with sausage: mix ¼ kg finely minced cooked meat with ⅛–¼ kg sausage meat, 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs, 2 eggs and a little stock; knead and roll into a short, thick log, coat in flour or in egg and breadcrumbs, and bake in a tray with ghee in a moderate oven for an hour, basting several times; serve hot with brown sauce or cold in slices.

osool-166.title: Oven-Baked Minced Meat Patties
osool-166.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-166-i8.name: Fried potatoes and tomato or brown sauce, for serving

instructions.1: Fry the onion until golden, then add the remaining ingredients and knead well with the eggs.
instructions.2: Divide the mixture and shape into rounds an inch thick.
instructions.3: Place on a greased tray and put a small knob of ghee on each patty.
instructions.4: Bake in the oven for 20 minutes.
instructions.5: Serve with fried potatoes and tomato or brown sauce.

osool-167.title: Baked Leftover Meat Mold
osool-167.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-167-i6.name: Ghee and breadcrumbs for the mold

instructions.1: Brush the mold with warm ghee and sprinkle it with breadcrumbs.
instructions.2: Mix the ingredients and bind with the eggs, adding a little sauce if needed; season the mixture well and press it into the prepared mold.
instructions.3: Bake in a moderate oven for 40 minutes.
instructions.4: Turn out of the mold, pour a little brown sauce around it and serve the rest of the sauce in a sauceboat.
instructions.5: Potato mold stuffed with meat: mix ½ kg boiled mashed potatoes with 1 tablespoon ghee and 1–2 eggs and season; line a greased, breadcrumbed mold with it, leaving a hollow in the middle, and fill the hollow with a mixture of ¼ cup thick brown sauce, ¼ kg cooked minced meat and parsley; cover with greased paper and bake, then turn out and pour the brown sauce around it.

osool-168.title: Leftover Meat with Mashed Potato Topping
osool-168.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Make the brown sauce, add the meat and season the mixture well.
instructions.2: Put the meat in a greased ovenproof dish and cover with the potatoes, then rough up the potatoes with a fork into a peaked shape.
instructions.3: Dot the top with small pieces of butter or ghee at intervals.
instructions.4: Bake in a moderate oven for 20 minutes until the top browns, then serve.

osool-169.title: Levantine Baked Kibbeh with Spiced Mince and Pine Nuts
osool-169.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-169-i6.name: For the filling: coarsely minced meat

osool-169-i7.name: For the filling: coarsely minced tail fat

osool-169-i9.name: For the filling: onion, thinly sliced into rings

osool-169-i10.name: Ghee (for the filling, the tray and the top)

instructions.1: For the filling: heat 2 tablespoons ghee, add the onion and stir for two minutes, then add the meat, tail fat, pine nuts and spices and stir over low heat until cooked.
instructions.2: Mince the meat finely with a little salt, then mince the onions, add them to the meat and mince twice more.
instructions.3: Pick over the bulgur, wash it several times and drain it well, then add it to the minced meat and mix well; season with salt, pepper, allspice and cinnamon and mince the mixture once or twice.
instructions.4: Grease a tray with ghee and spread a layer of the mixture 1 to 1½ cm thick over the bottom.
instructions.5: Spread a layer of the spiced mince and pine nuts over it and press down by hand, then cover with another layer of the kibbeh mixture.
instructions.6: Smooth the top well, cut it into diamonds like baklava and cover the surface with melted ghee.
instructions.7: Bake in a fairly hot oven for 20 to 30 minutes until cooked and browned on top.
instructions.8: Drain off the ghee and serve.

osool-170.title: Steamed Meat Molds
osool-170.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-170-i9.name: Sautéed peas and carrots and brown sauce, for serving

instructions.1: Fry the chopped onion in the ghee and lift it out, then brown the flour.
instructions.2: Add the stock gradually while stirring and bring to a boil; add the meat, parsley and onion, season the mixture well and add the eggs.
instructions.3: Grease 4 small molds, divide the mixture among them and cover with paper brushed with ghee.
instructions.4: Steam for half an hour.
instructions.5: Turn out of the molds, cover with brown sauce and garnish with sautéed peas or carrots.
instructions.6: Raw meat molds: made the same way using raw meat instead of cooked, and steamed for an hour.

osool-171.title: Cold Steamed Meat Mold
osool-171.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-171-i8.name: Lettuce and vegetable salad, for serving

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients together and season well.
instructions.2: Brush a mold with warm ghee and coat it with breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into the prepared mold and steam for 40 minutes.
instructions.4: Turn the meat out onto a suitable plate and leave to cool; garnish with lettuce and serve with the vegetable salad.

osool-201.title: Boiled Poultry (Duck, Goose, Turkey or Pigeon)
osool-201.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-201.culturalNotes: The broth (fat) from boiled poultry is used to cook other dishes such as kishk, freekeh and vegetables.

osool-201-i1.name: Cleaned bird (a duck, goose, turkey or pair of pigeons)

osool-201-i2.name: Salt and flour for rubbing the bird

osool-201-i6.name: White sauce or parsley, for serving

instructions.1: Clean the bird, rub it well with flour and rinse; truss it by tucking the legs into the bottom opening.
instructions.2: Bring the water to a boil and add the whole onion, a little cardamom and salt.
instructions.3: Put the bird into the boiling water and cook until tender, skimming off the scum whenever it appears. The time varies with the bird's age and size; somewhat older, pale-skinned birds are best for boiling.
instructions.4: Lift it out of the cooking water and serve covered with white sauce or simply boiled, garnished with parsley.

osool-202.title: Boiled and Fried Quail with Rice
osool-202.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-202-i2.name: Chopped onion rubbed with salt and pepper

osool-202-i4.name: Fluffy rice cooked in the quail broth

instructions.1: Pluck the quail dry (by hand, without water), then open and clean them like chicken.
instructions.2: Boil them in water with the chopped onion rubbed with salt and pepper until tender.
instructions.3: Lift them out of the pot and pat dry, then fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Serve with the fluffy rice cooked in the broth.
instructions.5: Boiled wild birds: boil in water for 10 minutes and discard the water, then cook in fresh clean water with salt and an onion rubbed with salt and pepper until tender; drain, fry and serve with fluffy rice.

osool-203.title: Cold Chicken with Salad and Mustard Sauce
osool-203.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-203-i5.name: Green olives and thin pickled cucumbers

instructions.1: Shred the lettuce as fine as hair, wash it and dry it in a clean towel.
instructions.2: Cut each chicken into eight pieces, removing the skin and bones.
instructions.3: Peel the tomatoes, cut each into quarters and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice; peel the eggs and cut them lengthwise.
instructions.4: Spread the lettuce over the bottom of a plate and arrange the chicken pieces neatly on top as you like.
instructions.5: Decorate the edge of the plate with tomato pieces, then cucumber or olives, then a piece of egg, and so on; serve with the mustard sauce.

osool-204.title: Cold Chicken Breasts with Tomato Cream Aspic
osool-204.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Remove the skin and bone from the breasts and cut them neatly into suitable pieces.
instructions.2: Dissolve the gelatin in 2 tablespoons water over low heat and add it to the strained tomatoes, stirring.
instructions.3: Whip the cream until thick, then add the tomato mixture and season well.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into a glass dish and arrange the cold chicken pieces around it.
instructions.5: Place the sautéed green beans around the chicken.

osool-205.title: Chicken in White Sauce with Egg and Lemon
osool-205.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-205-i4.name: Liquid: 1 cup milk and 1 cup stock, or 2 cups chicken stock

osool-205-i8.name: Parsley or boiled eggs, for garnish

instructions.1: Make the white sauce: melt the ghee, add the flour and stir without letting it color, then add the liquid while stirring until it boils; season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Add the egg yolks if using and heat gently, stirring constantly, without boiling; then take it off the heat and add the lemon juice.
instructions.3: Place the chicken, whole or in pieces, on a warm plate and cover with the sauce; garnish with parsley and lemon or with boiled eggs.

osool-206.title: Chicken Galantine
osool-206.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-206-i6.name: An onion and the chicken's neck bone, liver and gizzard, for the broth

osool-206-i8.name: Glaze (concentrated dark stock) or a cold sauce

instructions.1: Pluck the chicken without using water and remove the neck and feet, keeping the neck skin intact.
instructions.2: Split it along the back and remove the innards, then remove the bones with a short, sharp knife; wash well with salt, rub with flour and rinse.
instructions.3: Spread the chicken out and season with salt and pepper, then add a layer of sausage meat and smooth it well, followed by a layer of sliced eggs, then the almonds and pistachios.
instructions.4: Roll the chicken into a cylinder and shape it, then wrap it tightly in a cloth dusted with a little flour, twist the ends and tie them firmly.
instructions.5: Put it into boiling water with a little salt, an onion and the neck bone, liver and gizzard, and cook for 1½ to 2 hours, adding boiling water if needed.
instructions.6: Lift it out of the pot and drain, then remove the cloth and wrap it in another clean one; place it between two trays under a 2–3 pound weight in a cool place until completely cold (at least four hours).
instructions.7: Brush with glaze or cover with a cold sauce and serve whole or in slices on a bed of lettuce with tomatoes.
instructions.8: Boned chicken stuffed with spiced mince: stuff the boned chicken with a mixture of ¼ kg finely minced veal, an egg, 1 teaspoon chopped onion, 1 tablespoon soaked and squeezed breadcrumbs, 1 tablespoon ghee, nutmeg, salt, pepper and allspice; sew it closed, wrap in cloth and boil for an hour and a half with an onion, celery and cardamom, then cool in greased paper and glaze.

osool-207.title: Stuffed Boned Turkey (Turkey Galantine)
osool-207.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-207-i8.name: An onion and the turkey bones, for the broth

osool-207-i10.name: Glaze or an unsweetened aspic sauce (made with halal gelatin)

instructions.1: Pluck the turkey dry and bone it as for boned chicken, then wash and pat dry.
instructions.2: Mix the stuffing ingredients, knead well with the eggs and season.
instructions.3: Stuff the turkey with it in one piece and tie the legs neatly with linen string.
instructions.4: Wrap the turkey in a cloth, tie it firmly and boil it in water with an onion, salt and the turkey bones until tender.
instructions.5: Lift it out of the water and let it cool somewhat, then unwrap it; wash the cloth, wring it out well, wrap the turkey in it again and leave it in a cool place until completely cold.
instructions.6: Cut the breast into thin, even slices, then arrange them back in place and brush with glaze.
instructions.7: Serve on an oblong plate surrounded by boiled artichoke bottoms filled with sautéed vegetables (peas and carrots).
instructions.8: Oven-roasted stuffed turkey: prepare the turkey with the same stuffing and sew up the back; place it on its back in a tray greased with ghee and cover with ghee, roast in a hot oven for half an hour, then lower the heat and cook for about 3 hours covered with greased buttered paper, basting with ghee every 20 minutes; leave until the next day and serve cold.

osool-208.title: Braised Chicken with Vegetables and Rice
osool-208.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-208-i3.name: An onion, a piece of celery and a piece of carrot

instructions.1: Brown the chickens in the ghee, then add the prepared chopped vegetables, cardamom and water.
instructions.2: Season, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender, adding a little water whenever needed.
instructions.3: Lift the chickens out of the pot and strain the juices through a wire strainer.
instructions.4: Spoon the rice onto a plate and place the chickens on it, each cut into quarters; pour a little of the strained sauce over the chicken and serve the rest in a sauceboat; eat hot.

osool-209.title: Chicken in Browned Flour Sauce
osool-209.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-209.culturalNotes: Liver, gizzards, wings, head and neck can be cooked the same way.

instructions.1: Prepare the chicken and cut it into 4 to 8 pieces.
instructions.2: Brown the pieces in the ghee and lift them out.
instructions.3: Brown the flour in the remaining ghee until reddish brown, stirring constantly over low heat, then take the pot off the heat and add the water gradually while stirring.
instructions.4: Return the pot to the heat, add the onion, cardamom, salt and pepper and bring to a boil while stirring; then add the browned chicken pieces, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.5: Add some water if needed; the sauce should end up moderately thick.
instructions.6: Lift the cooked chicken into a deep dish and strain the sauce over it.

osool-210.title: Chicken in Tomato Sauce (Dama)
osool-210.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-210-i5.name: For the sauce: stock or water

instructions.1: Prepare and cut up the chicken, brown it in the ghee and lift it out.
instructions.2: For the sauce: fry the chopped onion in the remaining ghee, then add the strained tomatoes and cook until done; add the stock, season and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Put the chicken pieces in the sauce, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender, adding some water if needed.
instructions.4: Second method: cut a half-boiled chicken into 4 to 8 pieces and brown them in ghee; make the sauce with the remaining ghee and the chicken cooking broth, then continue as above.

osool-211.title: Pigeon and Vegetable Tagine
osool-211.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Clean the pigeons, split them in half and season with salt and pepper, then sauté in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Arrange the vegetables in the tagine in alternating layers with the sautéed pigeons in the middle.
instructions.3: Add the strained tomatoes, the ghee left from browning, a little water, salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Cover the tagine and bake in a hot oven for half an hour, then lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.5: Second method: sauté the pigeons and lift them out, then sauté the vegetables in the remaining ghee; layer the vegetables and pigeons in the tagine, cover with the tomatoes and water, season, and bake covered until done.

osool-212.title: Braised Chicken with New Potatoes
osool-212.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Prepare the chicken and season the inside with salt and pepper; put the liver, gizzard and two cardamom pods inside, then brown it whole in the ghee.
instructions.2: Add the onion, celery, carrot and a liter of water and cook over medium heat until tender.
instructions.3: Lift out the chicken, cut it into 4 pieces and remove the breastbone; keep it in a warm place, then strain the remaining sauce to remove the bits of vegetable.
instructions.4: Peel the small potatoes and fry them in a little ghee, then add the strained sauce and cook for about 10 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
instructions.5: Arrange the chicken pieces on a warm plate with the potatoes around them, then pour the sauce over.

osool-213.title: Braised Pigeons in Espagnole Sauce
osool-213.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-213-i2.name: Espagnole sauce (brown sauce with tomato and vegetables)

instructions.1: Prepare the pigeons and cut each into four pieces.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, brown the pieces and lift them out; then brown the boiled onions, lift them out and season.
instructions.3: Bring the espagnole sauce to a boil, add the pigeons and season; cover the pot and cook over low heat until the pigeons are tender.
instructions.4: Arrange the fried bread pieces on a warm plate, place the pigeon pieces on them and strain the sauce over.
instructions.5: Garnish the plate with the peas, carrots and onions.

osool-214.title: Chicken Külbastı (Pressed Pan-Fried Spring Chickens)
osool-214.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-214-i7.name: Fried potatoes and parsley, for garnish

instructions.1: Clean the chickens and prepare them by splitting them along the back; remove the breastbone and ribs and flatten them with a cleaver.
instructions.2: Season with salt, pepper, onion juice and lemon juice for at least a quarter of an hour.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee in a pan until very hot and lay the chickens in it; cover with a flat lid and weigh it down, and cook until the underside browns, then turn over and brown the other side.
instructions.4: Add the water and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.5: Lift out and place on a warm plate as they are, or cut each in two; garnish with the potatoes and parsley and drizzle with the remaining juices.
instructions.6: Pigeon külbastı: made the same way; the pigeons may also be left whole, trussed and cooked in a small pot instead of a pan.

osool-215.title: Pot-Roasted Turkey (Külbastı)
osool-215.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-215-i4.name: Two onions, a piece of celery and a piece of carrot

instructions.1: Prepare and truss the turkey and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, add the mastic and cardamom, then brown the turkey.
instructions.3: Add the chopped vegetables and a little water, cover the pot and leave over fairly low heat.
instructions.4: Lift the lid from time to time, turn the turkey and add some water, and continue until it is fully cooked.
instructions.5: Lift it out of the pot and serve hot with the fluffy rice; strain the remaining liquid in the pot and serve it hot in a sauceboat.

osool-216.title: Pigeons Stuffed with Bread and Liver
osool-216.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-216-i6.name: The pigeons' livers, cooked and chopped

instructions.1: Pluck the pigeons dry, open them along the back and remove the breastbone.
instructions.2: Mix the onion, garlic, bread, parsley and livers, knead everything well with the egg and season with salt, pepper and allspice; stuff the pigeons with it and sew them closed.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot and brown the pigeons in it, then add a little water, lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.4: Lift out of the pot, place on a plate, garnish with parsley and fried potatoes and pour the remaining liquid over them.
instructions.5: Chicken with bread stuffing: made the same way using a pair of spring chickens instead of pigeons.

osool-217.title: Boned Pigeons Stuffed with Minced Meat
osool-217.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-217-i6.name: Ghee
osool-217-i6.standardAmount: 1 tablespoon (for the stuffing) and 1 tablespoon for browning

osool-217-i8.name: An onion, a piece of celery and the pigeon bones

osool-217-i10.name: Glaze or green relish (kamikh), for garnish

instructions.1: Pluck the pigeons dry, open them along the back, remove the bones and clean them well.
instructions.2: Mix the stuffing ingredients and season well; stuff the pigeons with it and sew them closed, then wrap each in paper greased with ghee on both sides and tie the paper securely.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot and brown the pigeons in it, then add a little water along with the bones, the onion, the celery and salt; cover the pot and leave over low heat.
instructions.4: Lift the lid from time to time, turn the pigeons and baste them with a little water, until they are cooked.
instructions.5: Lift out of the pot, remove the paper, wrap them in fresh paper and leave until completely cold.
instructions.6: Leave them whole, perhaps brushed with glaze and garnished with green relish, or cut into slices and garnish.

osool-218.title: Pigeon and Freekeh Tagine
osool-218.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-218-i3.name: Chicken stock or the pigeon cooking broth

instructions.1: Prepare the freekeh and brown it lightly in the ghee, then add the liquid, salt and pepper and boil for 5 to 10 minutes with the pot covered.
instructions.2: Put half the freekeh in the tagine, then the pigeon, then the remaining freekeh.
instructions.3: Cover the tagine and bake in a fairly low oven until done.
instructions.4: Heat 1 teaspoon of ghee until very hot and sprinkle it over the top, then remove the lid for 5 minutes so the top browns.
instructions.5: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine and serve on a plate that suits its size.
instructions.6: Pigeon tagine with rice: made the same way using 1 small cup of rice instead of freekeh, with half the liquid milk and the other half pigeon broth.
instructions.7: Quail tagine with rice: 6 half-boiled quail, 1 small cup rice, 2 small cups quail broth and 1 tablespoon ghee, cooked like the pigeon tagine with rice.

osool-219.title: Fried Chicken with Sautéed Peas
osool-219.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-219.culturalNotes: Young birds are best for frying.

instructions.1: Drain the boiled chickens and pat them dry; fry them whole or in pieces, lift out of the ghee and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Arrange on a warm plate, garnish with the fried potatoes and sautéed vegetables, and serve with the tomato sauce in a sauceboat.
instructions.3: Fried pigeons: lift a pair of boiled pigeons out of the cooking water, pat dry and fry in very hot ghee; drain on paper and serve with fried potatoes and sautéed vegetables, or with triangles of white bread fried in ghee.

osool-220.title: Oven-Browned Turkey
osool-220.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-220-i4.name: For garnish: fluffy rice, fried vermicelli, artichokes stuffed with vegetables, stuffed tomatoes, or fried potatoes and brown sauce

instructions.1: Half-boil the turkey, then lift it out, pat dry and place it in a tray greased with ghee.
instructions.2: Cover the top with a little ghee and put the tray in the oven until it is cooked and browned on top, basting it from time to time with the ghee in the tray.
instructions.3: Place it on a large oblong plate and garnish with any of the listed accompaniments.
instructions.4: Quicker method: dry the boiled turkey thoroughly, then fry it in ghee on the stove; sprinkle the top with salt and pepper and serve garnished.

osool-221.title: Browned Duck or Goose with Roqaq
osool-221.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-221-i4.name: Roqaq (thin baked pastry sheets) and parsley, for serving

instructions.1: Brown the boiled duck in very hot ghee, then lift it out and sprinkle the top with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Place it on an oblong plate, garnish with parsley and serve with the roqaq.

osool-222.title: Breaded Chicken with Mustard
osool-222.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-222-i7.name: Fried potatoes and parsley, for garnish

instructions.1: Lift the chicken out of the cooking water before it is fully cooked, drain and pat dry.
instructions.2: Cut it into suitable pieces and remove the bones and skin.
instructions.3: Coat the pieces in the flour mixed with the mustard, salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and shallow- or deep-fry in ghee, then lift onto paper to absorb the ghee.
instructions.5: Arrange on a warm plate and garnish with the potatoes and parsley.

osool-223.title: Pigeon Cutlets with Sausage
osool-223.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Clean the pigeons, cut each in half and remove the bones except the thigh bone.
instructions.2: Season the pieces well with salt and pepper and shape them as much as possible like cutlets.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot and brown the pigeon pieces on both sides, then lift them out, cover with paper and weigh them down to keep their shape; leave like this until cold.
instructions.4: Cover both sides of the pieces with sausage meat and smooth it well.
instructions.5: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.6: Arrange the pieces on a ring of mashed potatoes with the sautéed vegetables in the middle and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-224.title: Chicken in Batter
osool-224.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into fairly small, even pieces and remove the bones and skin.
instructions.2: Mix the marinade ingredients, add the chicken pieces and turn them from time to time; leave for half an hour, then lift out, pat dry and coat in a little flour.
instructions.3: Dip them in the batter, lift out carefully and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Lift out of the ghee and drain on paper, then place on a plate lined with a paper doily, garnish with parsley and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-225.title: Grilled Pigeons
osool-225.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)
osool-225.culturalNotes: Birds for grilling must be young; pigeons and very small chickens are used most often.

osool-225-i5.name: Sautéed peas, grilled tomatoes, lemon and parsley, for serving

instructions.1: Prepare the pigeons and split them along the back; remove the breastbone and ribs or leave them in.
instructions.2: Season with lemon juice, onion juice, salt and pepper and leave for half an hour.
